daily.title: Trump praises Albanese as Quad unveils defence and minerals deals
daily.summary: With major talks in China approaching, US President Donald Trump, Anthony Albanese and their fellow Quad leaders deepen cooperation on defence and technology at a summit in Manila.

daily.title: Ukraine strikes major Crimean bridge as aerial attacks escalate
daily.summary: Ukrainian drones and missiles have struck a vital bridge linking Russia to the occupied Crimean Peninsula.

daily.title: Chalmers proposes rules to allow super to invest in housing, energy, startups
daily.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers will unveil his long-awaited changes to the rules guiding what super funds can invest in, facilitating riskier investments with possible higher returns, such as startups.

daily.title: Alleged murderer thought he was being robbed during drug deal, jury told
daily.summary: An Adelaide man has given evidence in his murder trial, telling a jury he wanted to "get back" at a man who had swung a knife at him during an attempted drug deal.

daily.title: Up to 100 armed people fight with axes, spears and crossbows in remote NT
daily.summary: A 24-year-old armed with a rifle has been arrested after allegedly firing a rifle in a fight, then crashing a stolen car, throwing three passengers from the vehicle's tray. It comes amid further unrest in Wadeye, involving fighting among up to 100 armed people.

daily.title: Nine-month wait leaves Australia in a Cricket World Cup conundrum
daily.summary: Australia's series finale against England on Wednesday will be the team's last ODI until August next year, posing problems as they try to plan a Cricket World Cup title defence.

daily.title: 11-year-old boy dies after being hit by car in Toowoomba
daily.summary: An 11-year-old boy has died after being struck by a car while riding a bicycle on a suburban street in Toowoomba, west of Brisbane.

daily.title: Queensland YouTuber brothers granted bail after police drug bust
daily.summary: Andrew Young and Stuart Douglas Blair Young were arrested in October following a three-month investigation into alleged drug trafficking across Toowoomba.

daily.title: Buses rerouted, stops closed during Story Bridge closure
daily.summary: If your bus crosses the Story Bridge, this is what you need to know for when the Brisbane landmark closes to traffic this summer holidays.

daily.title: New vice-chancellor appointed to lead embattled NT university CDU
daily.summary: After a series of high-profile controversies this year, Charles Darwin University has appointed a new vice-chancellor and president, who says regaining the community's trust in the institution will be paramount.

daily.title: Twins' death after freebirth could have been avoided, inquest hears
daily.summary: An inquest into freebirth and homebirth deaths has heard that a woman's previous traumatic birth experience was behind her decision to shun antenatal care that could have detected her high-risk pregnancy.

daily.title: Aboriginal protester guilty of trespass despite 'cultural responsibility' to forests
daily.summary: An Aboriginal woman has been found guilty of trespass after a Hobart magistrate rejected her claim that she was innocent because she had a "cultural obligation" to protect forests from logging.

daily.title: Canberra schools to lose funding under more 'equitable' model

daily.title: Bikie admits to inquiry he may have charged Vic taxpayers for shifts not worked
daily.summary: A Bandidos bikie who worked on a Victorian Big Build job site admits "it's possible" taxpayers were charged for shifts he did not work, as text messages show the effort the CFMEU went to to have him employed.

daily.title: Psychologist says teen 'doesn't want to remember' train station murder
daily.summary: A forensic psychologist gives evidence during the sentencing of a 16-year-old boy who murdered a vulnerable man alongside a group of teenagers at a Shellharbour train station.

daily.title: Power player banned for six AFL matches for betting on games
daily.summary: Port Adelaide footballer Josh Sinn has been banned for six matches for betting on AFL games, one of which involved his own club, the league has said.

daily.title: 'Bragyu' beef a milestone for famous outback station
daily.summary: One of the most remote cattle stations in northern Australia has started producing its own branded beef, from its herd of Wagyu Brahman cross cattle.

daily.title: Hundreds of tonnes of rubbish illegally dumped on WA roadsides each year
daily.summary: Tonnes of rubbish and potentially toxic old building materials are being dumped on Perth roadsides and nature strips by what is believed to be contractors and others avoiding council tip fees.

daily.title: The longer-term thinking driving Swimming Australia's newest event

daily.title: Quick wallaby outruns fox in rare Queensland beach chase
daily.summary: A wallaby has out smarted a fox during a fast and furious chase on a Queensland beach.

daily.title: Bodies of woman and toddler found in Melbourne lake

daily.title: Teen shot dead after stabbing stranger 'very much enjoyed' extremist content

daily.title: Boy, 13, faces 'nightmare without end' after teacher had his baby
